units.summary: Adds a test helper that returns the source paths of all mocked cp calls with backslashes normalized to forward slashes. It is used by the updated upgrade-prompt tests to assert which guide files are copied, and it has no production effect.
units.headline: New test helper normalizing mocked cp source paths
units.reason: New test-only helper in a *_test file; it cannot affect production behavior and only reads mock call data.

units.summary: Updates the upgrade prompt tests to the new split guide layout (shared.md plus different-major, same-major or future-defaults). It adds tests for guide selection and for which files get copied. It also drops the assertions that a codemod command is written to a guide file, and replaces them with checks that nothing is read or written for same-major updates.
units.headline: Tests updated for split agentic-upgrade guides and copy behavior
units.reason: Expectations and inline snapshots were changed to match new behavior and some assertions were removed, which can hide regressions, even though new tests were added.
risk_signals: expectations changed to match new behavior
removed assertions on codemod command content
focus: Removed assertions that the codemod command 'upgrade <version> --yes --skip-adoption' is written into the guide for canary and future cases are covered elsewhere
Inline snapshots of the new prompt text match what next-upgrade.ts actually emits
Negative checks on copied sources (future-defaults.md, /02-pages/) rely on normalized paths and a clean cp mock between tests
